// diagnostic

E1112

{method} needs at least one task branch

What

{method} needs at least one task branch

Why

A task combinator must have a child to join or select

Fix

Write {method} {{ work() }} with one or more branches

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1112: tests/ui/empty_task_combinator.stderr.

 Why: A task combinator must have a child to join or select
 Fix: write `task.all` { work() } with one or more branches
